item.title: Local Review: Socrates, Plato — Aristotle - SLUG Magazine
item.description: It’s worth noting that Phillips was only 17 when he recorded and released Aristotle. That’s a courageous labor of love for just one guy whose graduation cap is still warm.

item.title: Review: Johnny Blue Skies — Mutiny After Midnight - SLUG Magazine
item.description: I listened to Mutiny After Midnight by Johnny Blue Skies over a dozen times. What proceeds is a raw, rock-heavy coalescence of edgy hedonism and revolution.

item.title: Cinematographer James Whitaker Talks DTF St. Louis
item.description: DTF St. Louis cinematographer James Whitaker has built a career grounding big ideas in images that favor atmosphere over flash and character over spectacle.

item.title: Review: Ween – Bring out the Foos: Live 1996 - SLUG Magazine
item.description: Bring Out the Foos: Live 1996 is a record that proves to be extremely unusual for Ween both during its recording and its final release 30 years later.

item.title: Film Review: Bridgerton (Season Four) - SLUG Magazine
item.description: Bridgerton season four enchants with romance, drama, and a Cinderella story, keeping fans swooning with every twist and turn.

item.title: Film Review: The Bride! - SLUG Magazine
item.description: The Bride! was a genuine effort — that much is obvious — but it fails to stick the landing and doesn’t come close to honoring the campiness of the original.

item.title: Review: Mumford & Sons – Prizefighter - SLUG Magazine
item.description: There’s something about Prizefighter that feels like a warm, comforting hug. The record’s cover, a battered and bruised lighter, invokes the air of an heirloom.

item.title: The Pitt Cast on ICE - SLUG Magazine
item.description: I’m hardly alone in my obsession with The Pitt, as the medical drama has become the gold standard for quality television. Still, when I first saw ICE agents, I was shaken by it.

item.title: Local Review: Ritt Momney – BASE - SLUG Magazine
item.description: Is there a more Utah artist than Ritt Momney? That being said, where the hell has he been? The short answer is off on an adventure, as well as around.

item.title: Screenings So Bad: A Secondhand Screenings Special
item.description: In this special edition of Secondhand Screenings, we indulged in media so deplorable that it nearly killed us. This is Screenings So Bad!
